verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no built-in AI assistant or chat agent inside LlamaParse's Web UI that users can hand tasks to. What it does show is adjacent: AI-powered features such as prompt-generated extraction schemas, custom parsing prompts and the agentic parse tier, plus an MCP server that external agents call. None of these is an in-product assistant, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
